messages:
Alex K: morning team — quick async checkin: did: pushed alert tweak PR (#428) to reduce noise; fixed the flapping autoscaler rule; blockers: still seeing occasional 95th latency spikes on t2 instances; today: rotate oncall playbook, pair with Morgan on query batching rollout.

Morgan L: thx alex. checked the PR, left a small nit. can you post the link? i want to validate change on dedicated pool.

Alex K: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/428 — main change: increase 95th threshold from 200ms -> 300ms for cold-start edge cases; added cooldown 3m. didn't want to suppress real regressions.

Priya N: noted. i saw a related alert at 03:12 UTC — payload shows a KV-cache miss storm. i'm running a quick query to correlate req ids. might be a client-side caching issue.

Sam T: oncall: saw the same alerts, but after scaling they recovered. i left a pinned runbook step to 'force-bump cache TTL if > 3 consecutive misses' — is that safe?

Morgan L: agree for now. we should add a metric on prefix-hit-rate so we don't guess. i'll add a grafana panel.

oncall-bot: pagerbot: ALERT resolved — slo.latency_95 p95 > 300ms on prod-gpu-1 (3 instances). Pager: @Sam T, @Alex K.

Alex K: re: runbook — @Priya N can you add the exact query to the runbook? paste the command folks should run.

Priya N: `redis-cli --csv HGETALL prefix-cache:node:<node-id>` — it dumps miss counters. also check nginx downstream queue lengths: `curl -s http://localhost:9090/metrics | grep queue_length`

Sam T: :thumbsup: adding to runbook now. also, @Morgan L can you file a quick follow-up to instrument prefix-hit-rate with percentiles?

Morgan L: on it. will tag product and eng-platform. estimated 2 pts sprint.

Alex K: blocker: i couldn't repro locally the high-latency pattern — likely infra only. @Priya N can we capture an example req_id next time and keep payloads for 24h? maybe enable short retention in debug env.

Priya N: yep. i'll add a temporary flow: capture requests with header X-Debug-Trace for 24h into s3/debug-requests/<date>. permission limited.

Sam T: FYI i'm reworking alert noise rules: plan is to add a rolling window 3m AND at least 2 nodes affected before page. will test on staging later.

Alex K: nice. once staging looks good we can promote. last: code review pings — please review infra/pull/426 (autoscaler fix) and infra/pull/428 (alert tweak).

Morgan L: reviewing 426 now.

Priya N: reviewed 428, left LGTM after nit.

Alex K: thanks. i'm logging this as follow-up action items: 1) add prefix-hit-rate metric (Morgan), 2) add runbook command (Priya), 3) alert-vote PR to staging (Sam). i'll update the changelog.

Morgan L: sounds good. small scheduling note: I'm OOO tomorrow morning until 11:00 PT — please ping if urgent.

Alex K: ack. i'll cover pings until then. thanks.
